question:
Select the correct option that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

TRIC_TRI_KT_IWK_R_TK
solution:
Given :TRIC_TRI_KT_IWK_R_TK

By checking options :

Option 1) KZRTI → TRIC__**K**__ / TRI__**Z**__K / T__**R**__IWK / __**T**__R__**I**__TK → (It follows the pattern)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dccff9f6c2f044ff1d19b9fa2ddb268a7439d73066aedc010fb18a7d14eaa43.png] 

Option 2) KIRTA → TRIC__K__TRI__I__KT__R__IWK__T__R__A__TK → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 3) KBTIR → TRIC__K__TRI__B__KT__T__IWK__I__R__R__TK → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 4) KATIR → TRIC__K__TRI__A__KT__T__IWK__I__R__R__TK → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

So, out of all the options "Option - (1)" follows the pattern.

Hence, **"Option 1**" is the correct answer.
